title: Mu'minka Qarsoon
intro: Hoolalka awoodda badan, halkaas oo gaalnimada iyo kalitalisnimadu ay ka talinayeen, cod keliya oo run ah ayaa ka hadlay meel aan la filayn. Shakhsigan ayaa ku dooday awoodda inay ilaaliso farriin-qaade, iyagoo halis gelinaya ammaankooda si ay u sheegaan runta.
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa dhul kalitalisnimo weyn, anigoo u adeegaya taliye sheeganaya ilaahnimo.
Sannado badan ayaan qarinayay caqiidooyinkayga dhabta ah, anigoo ka baqaya cawaaqib xumada ka dhalan karta shaacintooda.
Markii rasuul calaamo cad la yimid, waan rumaystay, laakiin dadkaygu way shirqooleen.
Waxaan hor istaagay kaligii-taliyihii iyo golihiisii, anigoo ku doodaya inaysan dilin rasuul aan waxba galabsan.
Waxaan uga digay ciqaabta quruumihii hore ee diiday runta, sida qoomkii Nuux iyo Caad.
Ilaahay baa iga badbaadiyay shirqooladoodii xumaa, waxaana arkay burburkii nidaamkii dulmiga badnaa.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Difaacidda nebi ka dhanka ah dilka
Dhisidda munaarad si aad cirka u gaarto
Kala qaybinta badda si loo baxsado
trial.answer: Difaacidda nebi ka dhanka ah dilka

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Laga badbaadiyay waxyeello intii dulmiga lagu halaagsanaayay
Dab ayaa lagu tuuray oo soo baxay isagoo aan waxba gaarin
Afartan sano oo cidlada ku dhex wareegayay
outcome.answer: Laga badbaadiyay waxyeello intii dulmiga lagu halaagsanaayay

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
